summary: Resumed Phase 3 (cs5Combined_seed_excludes) per continuation handoff 02. Attempted the necessity-transfer conjecture as directed: landed cs5Combined_necTransfer (sorry-free, axiom-clean), showing CS5Combined-derivability of tau_L(Psi)->tau_R(A) implies CS5-derivability of box(Psi)->box(A). Proved this is INSUFFICIENT (vacuous at Psi:=A, the hardest case, since box(A)->box(A) is trivially true), exhausting the necessitation/K/cross-axiom algebraic route. Additionally performed a feasibility analysis (paper only, no Lean) of report 02's derivation-height-induction fallback and found it is NOT a cheaper alternative to the already-ruled-out semantic route 1: any sufficient invariant must be closed under ax/modus_ponens for arbitrary contexts (making it a semantic truth-predicate in disguise), and a concrete toy valuation fails because H is quasi-prime (disjunction property only), not negation-complete, so it cannot faithfully represent w |= tau_L''H for compound formulas -- only the full canonical model (comparable to CS5Segment/cs5Mreach) can. Both of report 02's proposed routes therefore bottom out at canonical-model-scale machinery. Phase 3 marked [PARTIAL] (not [BLOCKED] -- no proved obstruction). Phases 4-5 not started. Full CI pipeline green (lake build, lake test, checkInitImports, lint-style all clean).

blockers.why_stuck: Three dispatches (1 opus-tier research + 2 implementation, including this one) have now confirmed: (a) no homomorphic/compositional translation can witness this direction (report 02); (b) no atom-indexed semantic model can either, including L-uniform, mirrored, naive 2-point, and naive identify-both-copies models (report 02 + this dispatch); (c) the necessitation/K/cross-axiom algebraic route caps out at boxed-antecedent consequences, provably insufficient (this dispatch); (d) the derivation-height induction report 02 recommended as the mechanizable fallback is NOT independent of the semantic route's difficulty -- both require canonical-model-scale (Lindenbaum, all-quasi-prime-theories) structure, since H is quasi-prime but not negation-complete, so no finite/toy characterization of H's compound-formula membership is possible without a genuine truth lemma.

Do NOT re-attempt: the necessitation/K/cross-axiom algebraic route (exhausted); any homomorphic/compositional translation; any atom-indexed semantic model (mirrored, L-uniform, naive 2-point, naive identify-both-copies).
